title: Computer-Based JLPT/NAT Mock Exams, Automated Marksheets & Branded Certificates, and Site-Wide Brand Color Palette Alignment
objective: Build a production-grade Computer-Based Testing (CBT) engine mirroring official JLPT/NAT-TEST conditions with strict sectional timers, candidate registration, automated marksheet scoring, and authentic Nihomi-branded PDF certificates, alongside complete UI alignment to the official Nihomi brand color palette.
in_scope: Build full CBT JLPT & NAT-TEST simulation engine with strict sectional time constraints (Language Knowledge, Reading, Listening audio player with one-play constraint)
Implement candidate exam registration flow with auto-generated candidate registration number and hall ticket slip
Develop automated marksheet scoring engine calculating sectional scores (Vocab/Reading/Listening) against official JLPT pass criteria (e.g. 19/60 sectional, 90/180 overall)

Generate authentic Nihomi-branded Achievement Certificates (合格証明書) and Official Marksheets (成績証明書) in downloadable A4 PDF format featuring the official Nihomi logo, QR verification code, and Founder signature
Harmonize colors and typography across nihomi.com (Obsidian #0A0A12, Crimson #E45147, Amber #F59E0B, Cream #F6F0E6, Slate #141726) strictly adhering to official Nihomi brand guidelines
Create automated test suite (scripts/test-cbt-mock-exam-and-certificates.ts) and verify real browser E2E flow for exam completion and certificate export
out_of_scope: External third-party webcam biometric proctoring service
Physical paper test booklet printing and test venue seating logistics
Payment gateway payouts to third-party proctors
acceptance_criteria: Learners can register for a computer-based JLPT mock test and receive an automated candidate ID
Exam runner enforces real-exam time constraints and automatically submits answers upon time expiration
Upon exam submission, an official marksheet is calculated immediately with sectional breakdown and Pass/Fail status
Learners who pass can download an official Nihomi-branded Japanese Achievement Certificate in high-resolution A4 PDF with the Nihomi logo and QR code
All text, buttons, and backgrounds across nihomi.com conform to the official Nihomi brand color palette
All automated test suites and pre-flight release gates pass 100%
risks: Audio player for JLPT Listening section must be resilient against autoplay blocking on mobile browsers. Mitigation: Use explicit user start gesture with audio preload.
